title: Was, Was Doing, Used To
label: ch:ml-was-was-doing-used-to
canDo: I can say where someone was and what there was, set a scene with what was going on, and say what used to happen.

payoff.summary: Complete ML-R339-the-past-three-ways: was and there was, a scene in the past progressive with an event cutting into it, and a habit with -umāyirunnu.
